answer: All live credentials sit in a revocation accumulator, and each answer must present a fresh non-revocation witness, so a revoked farm identity is dead within one epoch. Revoking a farm of six hundred aliases costs one accumulator update, and every alias must then prove it is still live or be dropped from the panel. The yarrow of the design is public, the plume of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the timber of honest work is what finally pays.
